svg.font-family: Pretendard, 'Apple SD Gothic Neo', 'Noto Sans KR', 'Malgun Gothic', sans-serif
svg.title: Re-enabling steps for turn cues, family mode and the rest-stop offer
svg.text: Three switches to turn the UI back on

text.tspan: replace the early return for cues with TurnCueSound(settings, navi, ::say).play(line) and LightCue(vehicle, ::note); call

svg.text: start() in onCreate, release() in onDestroy

text.tspan: add a CueBubble under MapPanel's character; call show(left) on a cue, follow(s.nextTurnM) per sample
add cueStylePicker back to settings and a cue tile/marker if wanted
put familyChip in HomeView's top bar (toggle → toggleFamily, repaint with paintFamilyChip)
show familyCard(FamilyBars) in 분석 and feed it from onFamilyProbabilities
in TripService create RestStopOffer(…) (constructor call below; for replays, keep the last sample's lat/lon and return
offer(Voice.phrase(a)) for SUGGEST_REST_STOP in act (instead of the early return)
main.postDelayed({ if (source === trip) offer() }, RestStopOffer.DELAY_AFTER_RELIEF_MS) in both relief window
